title: Harkin-Engel Protocol signed
summary: Industry, US lawmakers and others agreed a plan to end the worst forms of child labor in cocoa, with time-bound steps.

title: First Protocol deadline passes unmet
summary: Reporting widely describes the first deadlines as missed and later extended. Exact wording of each deadline to be checked against the DOL page.

title: Lindt launches its Farming Program
summary: Lindt says the program has been its responsible-sourcing standard for cocoa since 2008.

title: Declaration of Joint Action and Framework of Action
summary: The US, Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire and industry set follow-up commitments. A 70% cut in worst forms by 2020 is widely cited; check the DOL page.

title: Lindt introduces unannounced farm visits
summary: Swissinfo reports Lindt began unannounced farm visits in 2016.

title: Lindt: 100% of beans via Farming Program
summary: Lindt states all cocoa beans have come through the program since 2020.

title: NORC: 1.56M children in cocoa child labor
summary: NORC, funded by the US DOL, estimated about 1.56M children in child labor in cocoa in Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire in 2018/19, about 1.48M in hazardous work. Industry's 2020 reduction goal was not met.

title: Lindt: 8,491 surprise visits, 87 child workers
summary: Press cites Lindt's own reporting: 87 child workers found in 8,491 unannounced visits in 2021 (year per swissinfo). A Ghanaian journalist quoted there called the number low. Original report to be located.

title: Lindt targets 100% CLMRS coverage by 2025
summary: Lindt's 2021 report set a goal that all cocoa from child-labor-risk countries comes from households covered by a monitoring and remediation system by 2025.

title: Swiss TV documentary on Tepa, Ghana
summary: SRF reported children working on farms in the Tepa area linked to Lindt supply. Lindt said it takes such cases seriously.

title: Lindt 2030 Sustainability Plan
summary: Lindt publishes its 2030 plan and commitments.

title: CLMRS target year: outcome unconfirmed
summary: We could not confirm whether Lindt reached 100% coverage by 2025.

title: Lindt: all cocoa Rainforest Alliance Certified
summary: Lindt says that from 2026 all cocoa is sourced as certified; the seal will appear gradually and not on every product.

title: Complaint moved to federal court in Washington, DC
summary: International Rights Advocates' complaint alleges Lindt misled consumers about efforts to end child labor in Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire. These are allegations. Lindt denies them.

title: Press coverage and Lindt's denial
summary: Reuters-led coverage; Lindt says it condemns child labor, has supplier protocols and investigates suspected cases.
